text.p: 1455 GMT - The Swiss franc closed slightly firmer ahead of release of Swiss first quarter GDP due on Thursday.
Swiss banks polled by Reuters expected GDP to show a 0.3 percent increase versus the fourth quarter of 1997, and a 0.3 percent drop against the first quarter 1996.

One dealer said the franc firmed on uncertainty created by the Swiss National Bank's (SNB) failure to add liquidity to the money market Tuesday and Wednesday, in view of its strategy of keeping the market liquid and pressure on the franc.
But a Swiss central bank spokesman said Wednesday with release of the SNB's 10-day statement that it would to continue to make sure that the Swiss money market would remain liquid.
Swiss money market traders also said there was adequate liquidity available.
* The dollar closed at 1.4357/4367 francs versus the Tuesday close of 1.4420/4430.
* The mark ended at 83.77/80 centimes versus 84.10/13 centimes.
